The posts are full-time and contract-based, with an honorarium of Rs. 5978 per month, and candidates must apply on the prescribed format in handwriting, in an envelope marked with the post name. content_sections.heading: About KGBV Gautam Buddh Nagar
content_sections.text: Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (KGBV) are residential girls' schools run in Gautam Buddh Nagar district. This notice is issued under the signature of the District Basic Education Officer, Gautam Buddh Nagar, to appoint contract-based non-teaching staff to vacant posts in these schools. Honorarium follows the instructions of the State Project Office, and original records of selected staff are kept at the District Project Office.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The Assistant Cook application is offline. The notice gives these instructions for preparing it: The application must be on the prescribed format (the notice calls itself a notice with conditions and the format of application), and only a clean, neatly handwritten or written application will be accepted. The name of the post applied for, with the subject, must be written clearly in bold letters on the envelope. A separate application must be made for each post. Self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures must be attached. The address to which the envelope goes, the mode of sending (post or by hand) and the last date are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice has one post, Assistant Cook, with 3 vacancies. The category-wise break-up is: Location-wise, KGBV Dadri has 2 vacant posts and KGBV Dankaur has 1 vacant post. The number of vacancies may decrease or increase, and post-wise reservation will then be decided by the selection committee. Class 8 pass. Should not be suffering from physical disability or an infectious disease. Should be skilled in cooking. Only women candidates are eligible for the Assistant Cook post. The age limit for all posts is a minimum of 25 years and a maximum of 45 years as on 01 April 2026. Reservation will be given as per the provisions laid down by the State Government. The Assistant Cook post carries an honorarium of Rs. 5978 per month. Honorarium on all posts is payable as per the instructions issued from time to time by the State Project Office. It will be paid only after the certificates submitted at selection are verified with the board or examining body concerned and the Aadhaar and residence certificate are verified. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following, issued by the competent authority, must be attached to the application: Mark sheets Certificates (educational and training) Character certificate Caste certificate Residence certificate The originals of all these documents must be produced at the time of the interview or counselling.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Assistant Cook post will be made on the basis of an interview. Candidates must bring the original certificates of all the documents enclosed with the application to the interview or counselling. No travel allowance will be paid for coming to and going from the interview or counselling. The date and venue of the interview are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Assistant Cook post is full-time and contract-based. After appointment, night stay at the school is compulsory, and no other member related to the employee will be kept with her. Selection is for the academic session 2026-27 (till 31 March 2027). The committee has the right to extend the contract to the next academic session only if work and conduct are found satisfactory; if services are not satisfactory, the contract may be ended at any time without prior notice. Original records will be kept safely at the District Project Office after verification. In unavoidable circumstances the notice may be cancelled without giving reasons, and no claim will be accepted for it; the notice is subject to clerical error. All selections are subject to the orders passed by the Hon'ble Court in petitions filed before it.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Cook vacancies are there in KGBV Gautam Buddh Nagar?
faq.answer: There are 3 Assistant Cook vacancies: 2 at KGBV Dadri and 1 at KGBV Dankaur, with 1 each for UR, OBC and SC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for KGBV Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: The candidate must be Class 8 pass, skilled in cooking, and not suffering from physical disability or an infectious disease.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the KGBV Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a minimum of 25 years and a maximum of 45 years as on 01 April 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of KGBV Assistant Cook in Gautam Buddh Nagar?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 5978 per month, payable as per the instructions of the State Project Office from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. Can men apply for the KGBV Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: No. Only women candidates are eligible for the Assistant Cook post.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for KGBV Gautam Buddh Nagar Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed format neatly in handwriting, attach self-attested copies of the listed documents, and write the post name with the subject in bold letters on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KGBV Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: Selection for the Assistant Cook post will be on the basis of an interview, where original documents must be produced.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KGBV Assistant Cook job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a full-time contract-based post for session 2026-27 (till 31 March 2027), which the committee may extend only if work and conduct are satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Is night stay compulsory for KGBV Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: Yes. After appointment, night stay at the school is compulsory, and no related family member may be kept there.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the KGBV Assistant Cook interview?
faq.answer: No. No travel allowance will be paid for attending the interview or counselling.
